speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The bells have been at it since before eight. St Helen's first, and then every steeple inside the wall.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Her Majesty is two-and-sixty today. Is the whole city ringing for that?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: For that. They took it up from this tower.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the parish pays for the ringing in ale, and ale is a charge I can count.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Must every noise be put down as a charge?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: In this parish it is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the bells their morning, Mistress. I am not here to argue a bill.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The Mayor is in his pew. He has the chain on.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Hear him. He gives the responses as a man reads a bill of lading.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Short, and done. He is not speaking to me.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The sword-bearer stands at the end of the pew, and he has not shifted.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And fourteenthly.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There. I have shifted my feet, and the glass is turned, and I am not ashamed of either.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seven weeks of him remain.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The parish knows it to the day. He will sit out every one of them in that chain.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Seven weeks, and he answers as if the chain had no date.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him sit. The responses are his work, and they are finished.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Length of days, and the mercies of a long reign. I am not done with the number.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You may keep the number, Master Thwaite. My feet have had their say.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not write the bells down twice. Once is the charge she means.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once is enough. I have heard them.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will hear them again at four, if you are still in the street. They do not stop because a man has sat down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will be at a table by then, and home after. The bells can go on without my leave.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Home is a quiet word in a ringing parish.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit till the glass is honest. Then we stand, and not before.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sat. Fourteenthly is the word I am taking out of the morning.
